text: Before this morning: the lady tells her fears to the man she looks to for help
why: ¶20 says she has told him her fears and he answered soothingly; this came before her early-morning journey.

text: That morning: the lady answers Holmes
why: In ¶20 the lady replies to Holmes during the morning visit.

text: Why can the one who cares for her be of so little aid? — he takes her fears for fancies
id: q.why_little_aid=he takes her fears for fancies
why: ¶17 says he can be of little aid and ¶20 says the man she looks to treats her fears as fancies; linking them is a fair possibility.

text: Are the lady's fears well founded?
why: ¶20 calls her fears vague and based on small points, and says he doubts them, so the question arises naturally.

text: Are the lady's fears well founded? — her fears are well founded
why: A plain possibility: she is terrified and speaks of dangers around her.

text: Are the lady's fears well founded? — they are the fancies of a nervous woman
id: q.fears_real=they are the fancies of a nervous woman
why: ¶20 uses this very phrase for how the man regards her fears.

text: What lies behind the dangers the lady speaks of?
why: She speaks of 'the dangers which encompass me' without explaining them, and the wording assumes no answer.

text: What lies behind the dangers the lady speaks of? — someone would lose her income when she marries
id: q.danger_cause=someone would lose her income when she marries
why: ¶17 says marriage will give her control of her own income, which implies someone else now holds it, so a reader can consider this.

text: What lies behind the dangers the lady speaks of? — the marriage itself is the danger
id: q.danger_cause=the marriage itself is the danger
why: She has mentioned her coming marriage and her fiancé dismisses her fears, so this is a reasonable possibility that reveals nothing.

text: What lies behind the dangers the lady speaks of? — the danger has nothing to do with her money
id: q.danger_cause=the danger has nothing to do with her money
why: A plain alternative possibility that asserts nothing new about the story.
